title: CoC7 Dialogues
description: Branching NPC dialogues for theatre-of-the-mind scenes: authored as journal pages of a dedicated 'Dialogue node' type, triggered by clicking a scene Region carrying a 'Dialogue' behavior, played in a full-screen overlay (NPC portrait, blurred scene, choices). Fully client-side, so players can talk to NPCs even when the Keeper is offline. Placeholders adapt the text to the investigator's name and gender.

recommends.reason: Paid dialogue choices (cost drawn from Spending Level, then Cash, then Capital) need coc7-ledger 0.6.0+; without it paid choices simply refuse.
Quest directives on dialogue choices (give/status/objective) write Simple Quest 'quest' pages into a player-owned quest log; without Simple Quest those directives are simply refused.
